# TractorVS — tractor specifications and independent comparison reference
> Independent, source-aware information about published agricultural tractor models, technical terms, comparisons and documentation methods. Not a tractor seller or a source of firsthand field-test results.

Website: https://tractorvs.com/
Language versions: The tractor catalogue and article index have ten language versions. Full-text tractor selection and Başak 2075 BK articles are available in ten languages; four other long technical articles currently have English and Turkish text only.
Index and canonical URLs: https://tractorvs.com/sitemap-index.xml
Image sitemap: https://tractorvs.com/image-sitemap.xml

## Start here
- [Published tractor models (English)](https://tractorvs.com/tractors/): model pages with year, market and equipment variant where known, specifications and document links.
- [Yayımlanmış traktörler (Türkçe)](https://tractorvs.com/tr/tractors/): yayımlanmış traktörlerin teknik özellikleri ve belgeleri.
- [Data methodology](https://tractorvs.com/methodology/): how identity, sources, measurements, photos and missing values are handled.
- [Veri doğrulama yöntemi](https://tractorvs.com/tr/methodology/): teknik verilerin nasıl kontrol edildiği.
- [Compare tractors](https://tractorvs.com/compare/): comparison of published model records.
- [Articles & technical guides](https://tractorvs.com/articles/): verified published editorial articles and their actual language coverage.
- [Makaleler ve teknik rehberler](https://tractorvs.com/tr/articles/): yalnız gerçekten yayımlanmış içerik bağlantıları.

## Original technical explanations
- [How to choose a tractor](https://tractorvs.com/guides/choosing-a-tractor/): original evidence-based selection checklist, with ten true full-text translations.
- [Başak 2075 BK technical review](https://tractorvs.com/reviews/basak-2075-bk/): manufacturer-sourced model analysis, with ten true full-text translations.
- [Tractor parts and technical terms](https://tractorvs.com/guides/tractor-technical-terms/): plain-language explanations of parts and measurement pitfalls.
- [Traktör parçaları ve teknik terimler](https://tractorvs.com/tr/guides/tractor-technical-terms/): Türkçe açık örnekler ve teknik kavramlar.
- [What is a tractor PTO?](https://tractorvs.com/guides/pto-and-power-take-off/)
- [What is rear hydraulic lift capacity?](https://tractorvs.com/guides/tractor-hydraulic-lift-explained/)
- [How do engine horsepower and torque differ?](https://tractorvs.com/guides/tractor-engine-power-and-torque/)

## Interactive farm planning tools
The calculator and tractor selection assistant have ten language versions. Example inputs are not observed model fuel use or local prices.
- [Fuel cost and field time calculator](https://tractorvs.com/guides/farm-cost-calculator/): user-input estimates for fuel, effective field capacity, operating costs and service intervals.
- [Traktör yakıt maliyeti ve tarla süresi hesaplayıcısı](https://tractorvs.com/tr/guides/farm-cost-calculator/): kullanıcının kendi değerleriyle yaptığı hesaplamalar.
- [Tractor selection assistant](https://tractorvs.com/farm-advisor/): model screening based on published data and user-provided conditions.
- [Traktör seçim yardımcısı](https://tractorvs.com/tr/farm-advisor/): yayımlanmış veriler ve kullanıcının girdiği koşullarla ön eleme.
- Calculations and numerical equipment screening are estimates, not certified compatibility, safety approval, maintenance instructions or a manufacturer's actual consumption measurements.

## Important source and accuracy limits
- Always identify the exact model, variant, market and year before repeating a specification.
- Distinguish manufacturer documentation from reviewed independent technical sources; follow the citations on the specific model page.
- Do not treat different measurement standards or units as equivalent. Missing or conflicting values are not verified facts.
- Source-backed public entries are not firsthand tests, customer reviews, dealer offers or live price quotes.
- Draft and archived models are not public catalogue pages. The XML sitemap is the canonical list of crawlable public URLs.
- Approved image credits and reuse licenses appear on the corresponding pages.
- This file is an optional navigation aid; it does not claim that any AI search engine will cite or rank this website.
